chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Eat the citron after the meal, for the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon them) do that.

key_terms.الْأُتْرُجَّ: Citron, a type of citrus fruit
key_terms.يَفْعَلُونَ ذَلِكَ: They do that (referring to the practice)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice regarding eating citron after meals according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) recommends consuming citron (*utruj*) after meals, grounding the practice in the established tradition (*sunna*) of the Ahl al-Bayt. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Prophet's family as exemplars of both spiritual purity and practical wisdom, including health (*tibb*), where their daily habits are viewed as a source of barakah and well-being.
